# Framework Setup Guides

## Next.js (App Router)

```css
/* app/globals.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens/theme.css";
@source "../node_modules/@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/dist";
```

```tsx
// app/page.tsx — Server Component (FidoUI uses 'use client' internally)
import { Button } from '@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/button';

export default function Page() {
  return <Button color="primary" shade="dark">Click me</Button>;
}
```

No `next.config.js` changes needed.

## Next.js (Pages Router)

Same CSS setup as App Router. Components work in both `pages/` and `components/` directories.

## Vite + TanStack Router

```css
/* src/index.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens/theme.css";
@source "../node_modules/@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/dist";
```

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react(), tailwindcss()],
});
```

## Rails (Tailwind v4)

```css
/* app/assets/stylesheets/application.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens/theme.css";
@source "../node_modules/@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/dist";
```

## Rails (Tailwind v3)

```js
// tailwind.config.js
const fidoUITheme = require('@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens/v3');

module.exports = {
  content: [
    './app/views/**/*.{html,erb}',
    './app/javascript/**/*.{ts,tsx}',
    './node_modules/@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/dist/**/*.{js,cjs}',
  ],
  theme: {
    extend: fidoUITheme,
  },
};
```

## Font Setup

FidoUI uses the **Archivo** font family. Load it in your app:

```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

Or self-host the variable font files (available from Google Fonts).

## Troubleshooting

### Styles are missing

Tailwind isn't scanning the FidoUI package. Add the `@source` directive (v4) or `content` entry (v3).

### "use client" errors in Next.js

Import from per-component paths:

```tsx
// Correct
import { Button } from '@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/button';
```

### TypeScript can't find module

Ensure `moduleResolution` is `"bundler"` or `"node16"` in `tsconfig.json`.
